12/13 Case Studies: Social Media Driven Pumps

- $DOGE: Elon’s tweets

- $PEPE: Meme frenzy

- $GME: Reddit army

- $BLUR: Airdrop farming hype

All driven by community attention, not always fundamentals. https://t.co/BRpJmqRGeY

6/13  Retail Psychology & Viral Posts

When people see:
👉"This coin will 100x"
👉“Don’t miss the next $DOGE ”

They act on emotion, not logic.
Viral posts trigger #FOMO, and price surges follow.

#CoinDCXCollective https://t.co/01yAS76irR

3/13 The Hype Effect

When a project trends on Twitter

-Volume spikes
-Google search interest rises
-Retail rushes in

Projects use this moment to launch #Tokens , #NFTs , or updates — catching maximum attention.

Example: $DOGE, $PEPE, $BONK 🚀

#CoinDCXCollective https://t.co/0gYmvR5O6K
